propositions: sign-review deterministically fails with store-read-failure on untracked files in .tickets-tracker even when plan review passes, because resign.py:146 calls generation.collect without ignore_untracked=True
orchestrator.py:650 silently falls back to full LLM re-review instead of cheap drift-refresh probe when untracked files exist, due to missing ignore_untracked=True in the swallowed exception path
attest.py's two collect_plan_relation_snapshot calls (lines 139 and 406) omit ignore_untracked=True and can abort signing on the fallback path when no initial_generation snapshot is supplied
untracked files in the symlinked machine-wide .tickets-tracker cause racing sign-review failures across concurrent sessions, making the signing path non-deterministic under normal multi-session load

the fix passes ignore_untracked=True at all affected call sites because these are COMMITTED-head fingerprints that untracked files cannot change, consistent with the already-authoritative under-lock re-check in generation.py:173
